name: Secret Island
source:
Set in a modern fantasy world, Secret Island puts you in the shoes of a powerful sorcerer and battle-hardened mercenary. After being caught in a war you never wanted to be a part of, you fought just for the chance to get revenge on some people on the other side, just to be betrayed as you got your revenge. Shot and left at sea, you found yourself on an unknown island, saved by a group of intriguing women, not all of them human. Strangely, you've never heard of this place before.

As you settle into life on the island, you quickly realize something is amiss. People can't leave, despite hearing messages from the outside world. Mysterious magic seals protect various parts of the island. People don’t want to talk about other people living on the island. You are filled with questions about who else is living on the island, about who made the magic seals, what dangers lurk around, and why you are there. Both you and your newfound companions harbor secrets.

Explore the island. Discover the lore of this world. Meet new people, bring them to live with you, and delve into romantic relationships with them.

[From [url=https://nocturnaldev.itch.io/secret-island]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Secret Island》以现代奇幻世界为背景，你将化身为一名实力强大的术士兼身经百战的佣兵。被卷入一场原本无意参与的战争后，你之所以浴血奋战，只为寻找机会向敌方阵营中的某些人复仇；谁知大仇得报之际，你却遭人背叛，中枪后被弃置海上，最终漂流到了一座不知名的岛屿，被一群魅力十足的女性所救——而她们之中并非所有人都是人类。奇怪的是，你此前从未听说过这个地方。

在岛上安顿下来后，你很快察觉到事情有些蹊跷：尽管能接收到外界传来的讯息，岛上的人却根本无法离开；神秘的魔法封印守护着岛屿各处；居民们也对岛上的其他住客三缄其口。你的心中充满了疑问：岛上究竟还住着什么人？是谁布下了那些魔法封印？暗处潜伏着怎样的危机？而你又为何会流落至此？无论是你，还是你新结识的伙伴们，每个人心中都藏着秘密。

探索整座岛屿，发掘这个世界的背景传说；结识新伙伴，邀请她们与你同住，并与她们发展出亲密的恋爱关系吧。

[摘自[url=https://nocturnaldev.itch.io/secret-island]itch.io[/url]]
